what: Identify species in an audio file
title: Get started with birdnetR
text: BirdNET, can identify bird species present audio file. function returns prediction object can converted data frame. row resulting data frame represents single prediction specific 3-second interval. multiple predictions confidence threshold time interval, see multiple rows interval.
code: library(birdnetR)  # Load the BirdNET acoustic model model <- load_birdnet()  # Path to an example audio file (replace with your own file path) audio_path <- system.file("extdata", "soundscape.mp3", package = "birdnetR")  # Predict species in the audio file predictions <- predict(model, audio_path, min_confidence = 0.3)  # Convert to a data frame df <- as.data.frame(predictions)  # Example output: #   input                   start_time end_time                   species_name confidence #   soundscape.mp3                   0        3 Poecile atricapillus_...       0.8140557 #   soundscape.mp3                   3        6 Poecile atricapillus_...       0.3082857 #   soundscape.mp3                   9       12 Haemorhous mexicanus_...       0.6393781 # ...

title: Get started with birdnetR
text: processing many audio files, efficient keep predictions Python write disk without converting R data frames. practical pattern loop meaningful chunks (e.g. one folder one recording day) write one output file per chunk: keeps memory usage constant regardless total dataset size iteration discards previous prediction object creating next one. write_predictions() supports CSV, Parquet, NPZ formats. Choose based downstream workflow: Note: Parquet supported geo predictions — use CSV NPZ instead.
code: model <- load_birdnet()  # Folders of audio recordings, e.g. one folder per site audio_folders <- list.dirs("recordings", recursive = FALSE)  for (folder in audio_folders) {   files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.wav$", full.names = TRUE)   predictions <- predict(model, files)    out_file <- file.path("results", paste0(basename(folder), ".parquet"))   write_predictions(predictions, out_file) }

title: Load a BirdNET Model — load_birdnet_model
text: argument type specifies type model load: "acoustic": model species identification audio recordings. "geo": model species prediction based geographic location time. argument version specifies version model load, e.g., "2.4". Use supported_model_configurations() see supported versions. argument backend specifies backend use: "tf": TensorFlow backend, supports different precisions libraries CPU . "pb": Protobuf backend, can run GPU. GPU support requires additional system dependencies; see upstream birdnet documentation details. argument library used TensorFlow backend specifies library use: "litert": LiteRT library running TensorFlow Lite models. "tflite": standard TensorFlow Lite library. argument precision specifies precision model: "int8": 8-bit integer precision, efficient terms speed memory usage. "fp16": 16-bit floating point precision, good balance speed accuracy. "fp32": 32-bit floating point precision, accurate also slowest memory-intensive. Protobuf geographic models support "fp32" precision. get overview valid model configuration combinations use supported_model_configurations().

text: object BirdNET model object class birdnet_model_acoustic created load_birdnet(). files character vector one file paths audio files. multiple files provided, returned prediction object contain results files; resulting data frame (via .data.frame()) includes input column identifying source file prediction row. min_confidence numeric value set minimum confidence threshold predictions. min_confidence_custom named list element single numeric value set custom minimum confidence thresholds specific species. custom threshold override default one. top_k integer specifying number top predictions return time interval minimum confidence threshold. overlap numeric value specifying overlap duration seconds consecutive time intervals. Must interval [0.0, 3.0]. apply_sigmoid logical value indicating whether apply sigmoid function confidence scores. sigmoid_sensitivity numeric value adjusts sensitivity sigmoid function.  Must interval [0.5, 1.5]. bandpass_fmin, bandpass_fmax integer value set minimum maximum frequencies bandpass filter (Hz). species_list character vector list species names filter predictions. NULL, species considered. progress character string specifying type progress reporting. Options "minimal", "progress", "benchmark". n_producers integer specifying number threads producing audio batches. Must >= 1. NULL (default), Python backend default used. n_workers integer specifying number backend workers parallel inference. NULL (default), Python backend auto-detects based available CPU cores. batch_size integer specifying number audio segments evaluated per inference call. Must >= 1. NULL (default), Python backend default used. prefetch_ratio integer specifying many batches decode ahead processing. Must >= 0. NULL (default), Python backend default used. speed numeric value resampling multiplier accommodate different recording speeds. Must interval [0.01, 100]. NULL (default), Python backend default used. half_precision logical value indicating whether use float16 supported inference. NULL (default), Python backend default used. max_audio_duration_min numeric value specifying maximum total audio duration per call minutes. Must > 0. NULL (default), limit applied. ... title: birdnetR 1.0.0 (development version)
text: legacy model loaders (birdnet_model_tflite(), birdnet_model_protobuf(), birdnet_model_meta(), birdnet_model_custom()) removed. Use load_birdnet() load_custom() instead. load_model() renamed load_birdnet() distinguish future load_perch() loader (#45). predict_species_from_audio_file() predict_species_at_location_and_time() removed. Use predict() loaded model. labels_path() read_labels() removed. Use get_species_list(model) instead. available_languages() removed. Use supported_languages(). get_top_prediction() removed. Use dplyr::slice_max() birdnetTools package post-processing. labels argument load_custom() replaced species_list. predict() geo models now defaults min_confidence 0.03 match upstream Python birdnet default.

title: birdnetR 1.0.0 (development version)
text: load_perch() loads Perch v2 acoustic model (CPU ). returned model object compatible existing predict() .data.frame() workflows (#46). Device selection exposed, consistent load_birdnet(). load_birdnet() now supports type, version, backend, library, precision, language arguments flexible model loading. load_custom() gains advanced arguments classifier_type is_raven custom model configurations. supported_model_configurations() returns valid model configuration combinations. supported_languages() returns set supported language codes. get_species_list(model) retrieves species list loaded model. write_predictions() saves prediction results directly Python CSV, Parquet, NumPy format without crossing R boundary. birdnet_version() returns installed Python version, executable path, birdnet package version. predict() acoustic models now exposes performance parameters n_producers, n_workers, batch_size, prefetch_ratio, speed, half_precision, max_audio_duration_min; default NULL Python backend defaults used unless explicitly set. predict() geo models now exposes half_precision, defaulting NULL Python backend default used unless explicitly set.

title: birdnetR 1.0.0 (development version)
text: load_perch() internally hardcodes CPU upstream Python call; device argument exposed users (#46). supported_model_configurations() documentation now explicitly notes Perch v2 excluded table directs users load_perch() (#46). supported_model_configurations() longer advertises acoustic version "2" (Perch v2), loadable via load_birdnet() (#45). Integer-like parameter validation (top_k, bandpass_fmin, etc.) now silently accepts whole-number doubles (e.g. 5) addition integer values (e.g. 5L) (#45). .data.frame() acoustic geo prediction objects now converts results via Python dict helper calls to_structured_array() returns plain Python lists numpy arrays, bypassing pandas entirely. fixes corrupt data frames caused Arrow-backed StringDtype columns introduced pandas >= 2 pyarrow installed.
